login.title: Sign in to the dashboard
login.description: Admins only. Use the email you were invited with.
login.inviteOnly: Access is by invitation. Ask an existing admin for an invite.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.description: Choose a password to finish accepting your invite.
setPassword.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask an admin to send a new invite.
setPassword.passwordRequirement: Password must be at least 8 characters long

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password. Your other sessions end, and sign-in still asks for your second factor.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your admin email and we'll send a link to choose a new password. It works for one hour.
forgotPassword.sent: If that address belongs to an admin, a reset link is on its way.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

twoFactorSetup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
twoFactorSetup.description: Add a second step to your sign-in with an authenticator app. Confirm your password to start.
twoFactorSetup.required: This dashboard requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue.
twoFactorSetup.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or add the key below by hand, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactorSetup.backupCodesHint: These codes are shown only once. Store them somewhere safe: each one signs you in once if you lose your device.
twoFactorSetup.alreadyOn: Two-factor authentication is on for your account.
twoFactorSetup.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Everyone with an account in the app.
users.emptyHint: Try a different search, or clear the filters.

status.banned: User banned and signed out everywhere.

ban.notBanned: This user is not banned. Banning signs them out everywhere.
ban.confirmMessage: {0} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until the ban ends.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.confirmRevokeAll: {0} is signed out on every device and has to sign in again.

admins.title: Admins
admins.subtitle: People who can use this dashboard.

invite.description: They get an email with a link to set their password.
invite.name: Name (optional)

admins.confirmRemove: Remove {0}? They lose access to the dashboard right away. This cannot be undone.

status.disabled: Admin disabled and signed out everywhere.
status.enabled: Admin enabled. They can sign in again.
status.twoFactorReset: 2FA removed. They enrol again at their next sign-in.

admins.confirmResetTwoFactor: Remove two-factor authentication and backup codes for {0}? They enrol again at their next sign-in.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every admin action, newest first.
audit.howRecorded: Admin changes (bans, roles, sessions, invites, admins) are recorded before they run: if the audit log cannot record one, it is refused and nothing changes. Sign-ins, sign-outs, refused two-factor codes and used backup codes are recorded just after they happen and never block them, so one can be missing if the log was unavailable at that moment.

reasons.locked: locked after too many wrong codes

statuses.pendingHint: The change may or may not have been applied. It will be checked against the current state and resolved.
statuses.reconciledHint: Resolved later from the current state, not recorded when the action ran. A later action may have changed that state since.

audit.internalReason: Internal error (details are in the server log)

reconciledReasons.stateMatches: The current state shows the change.
reconciledReasons.stateDiffers: The current state does not show the change.
reconciledReasons.undecidable: The outcome cannot be told from the current state.

audit.filteredByTarget: Showing entries for one target only.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Headline numbers for the app.
analytics.placeholder: This page is a placeholder: the numbers are simple counts over the app database. Connect a real analytics source (PostHog, a warehouse...) to replace them.
